description: Fogeist default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/fogeist-character-sheet-row.png (service venv PIL, 7x7 medians; intake.json carries no swatches, so the five palette chips were sampled directly at y 592: x 2104 228,228,232 / x 2192 191,197,209 / x 2278 143,157,177 / x 2365 84,100,122 / x 2452 55,66,81) plus 5x5 medians of the drawn surfaces (front view x 82-617, side view x 1384-2444). Drawn-figure luminance shares: front 225+ 8.6 % (224,226,231), 205-225 15.6 % (212,216,225), 180-205 26.9 % (183,190,203), 150-180 15.5 % (157,168,186), 110-150 15.9 % (112,128,149), <110 17.5 % (73,83,98); side 5.4 / 12.5 / 26.5 / 26.8 / 15.6 / 13.1 %. NO GLOW (brief). The mist is semi-transparent: the core (head, neck, chest, body, tail) is OPAQUE (material fogeist_core); the crest + every wisp carry 'alpha' (Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a) on the alpha-blended material fogeist_mist (Eevee BLENDED, single-sided, no transparency overlap: smooth, never dithered); material.alpha multiplies every translucent region. The same chip tone may serve an opaque core region and a translucent mist region (separate regions because alpha is per region). The sheet's thin ink contour lines are line art, not modelled.
